profile.summary: Star Academy is a private nonprofit school in San Rafael, California, for students with learning differences. It is a state-certified non-public school serving students from grade 4 through age 22, with individualized programs and specialists in language arts, speech, math, occupational therapy and emotional wellness. It draws students from several Bay Area counties.

review.notes: Identity is sound (Star Academy, 4470 Redwood Hwy, San Rafael, a non-public school for learning differences; ProPublica lists Shining Star Foundation, DBA Star Academy, EIN 68-0221149, 'Operated a school'). However the summary claims 'state-certified' non-public school, which no cited page states (site only says NPS and WASC-accredited), and says 'grade 4' when the site says third grade (homepage and At a Glance), so the summary is not supported as written.
